Aisha (Partnerships): Heads-up 1: Vendor Jordan says their PO was auto-rejected by the marketplace intake due to a clause in their MSA. Procurement has put payment on hold. Can Legal advise on minimal acceptable language so procurement can proceed?
Tom (Legal): I reviewed the MSA. Clause reads like an anti-channel clause that effectively limits marketplace/reseller distribution. Marketplace policy disallows exclusionary reseller terms.
Ravi (Finance): Procurement won't move forward with anything that looks like a reseller exclusivity or non-compete. It triggers accounting and audit flags. We need a short alternative line we can accept.
Aisha (Partnerships): Jordan, can you paste the exact sentence? also @Tom, do we have precedent fallback wording used in prior marketplace deals?
Jordan (Vendor): Clause: "Vendor shall not distribute the Service via resellers, marketplaces or channel partners that compete with Vendor's established direct channel partners without prior written consent."
Marta (Ops): That's too restrictive for marketplace catalogs. Marketplace ops will auto-block.
Tom (Legal): Proposed safe substitute: "Vendor will not impose exclusive or unduly restrictive distribution constraints on resale through Customer or Customer-authorized marketplaces or resellers." It's intentionally short and non-exclusionary.
Ravi (Finance): That phrasing seems fine. Procurement requests an explicit line saying this won't change marketplace listing eligibility. Can Partnerships/OPS confirm?
Aisha (Partnerships): I'll escalate to marketplace-ops and vendor manager. Jordan, can you confirm acceptance of Tom's one-liner so we can avoid a round of redlines?
Jordan (Vendor): We can accept that text if Procurement provides a fast confirmation from marketplace that it won't cause delisting. We were auto-flagged previously and it slowed a launch.
Marta (Ops): Opening ticket MP-9021 now to get a policy review. ETA 4 hours for stewardship review. I'll include the exact proposed language and the vendor id.
ProcureBot: PO 2024-998 pending 1: hold code: CONTRACT_REDLINED_BY_LEGAL.
Tom (Legal): Once marketplace ops signs off, Legal will include the one-liner as an MSA amendment and sign. Jordan please post a one-line ack here to speed Procurement.
Jordan (Vendor): Ack, will accept proposed replacement and sign amendment.
Marta (Ops): MP-9021 update: marketplace ops confirmed the replacement is acceptable and will not trigger delisting. They asked that the vendor id be added to the ticket and PO metadata for the audit trail.
Ravi (Finance): Perfect. Procurement will update PO notes with MP-9021 and release for signature. Please ensure PO description includes ticket id and the accepted clause text.
Aisha (Partnerships): Done 1: added MP-9021 and the accepted clause to the PO description, pinging Procurement to proceed.
ProcureBot: PO 2024-998 status update 1: queued for signature.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. Closing thread once PO is fully signed. :white_check_mark:
